subject: Coolant expansion tank: filler cap, vent screw and level marks, on a 2010 BMW 328i (E90) with the 3.0L inline-6, shown so a home mechanic can see what the step is about. Step: "Release pressure and open the expansion tank cap".

mustShow.text: HERO: The plastic coolant expansion tank with a screw-on filler cap and a filler neck carrying MIN and MAX level marks.
The screw cap on the expansion tank; turned slightly counter-clockwise first to release pressure, closed until it clicks.
A small M10 vent (bleeder) screw on the expansion tank, closed during venting and loosened only while filling.
